svg.title: Jobs within 60 minutes by public transport, Belo Horizonte
svg.desc: A map of the municipality of Belo Horizonte covered by cells coloured by the share of the city's formal jobs reached within 60 minutes by walking and bus at the morning peak. The centre, inside the Avenida do Contorno, and the cells around it reach the most; the edges of the city the least. Half the residents reach 71.2% of the jobs or less.

g.text: Share of the municipality's 720,512 formal jobs reached from each cell,
walking and riding, at the morning peak (median of departures 07:00–07:59,
Tuesday 17 November 2026). Half the residents reach 71.2% or less.
Blank: cells without residents. Buses only: the feed has no metro
Jobs within an hour by public transport, Belo Horizonte
